data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's opening gross claims reserve at 1 January 2018 was GBP 92.031m. The report does not present an explicit gross prior-year reserve movement figure; calculation is complicated by a significant RITC/quota-share transfer (2015 & prior reserves from Syndicate 1955 into the 2016 year) which materially increased the 2016 underwriting-year reserves and distorts development tables. During 2018 the syndicate suffered multiple catastrophe losses (Hurricanes Michael & Florence, Typhoon Jebi and California wildfires) which the report states adversely impacted profit by GBP 3.2m. As a result the pattern of reserve change across lines includes both large reallocation/strengthening (notably in reinsurance/treaty balances) and current-year catastrophe impact, producing mixed directional movements across lines.
raw_causal_phrases: The increase in the year was due to 15.4% of the 2015 and prior year of account of reserves from Syndicate 1955 being transferred into the 2016 year of account of Syndicate 1856.
2018 was a difficult operating environment for the Syndicate with multiple catastrophe losses over the course of the year.
Hurricanes Michael and Florence, Typhoon Jebi and California Wildfires adversely impacted the Syndicate's profit by GBP 3.2m.

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit gross prior-year reserve movement (PYD) figure is provided. The gross claims development triangle is materially distorted by a quota-share/RITC transfer (2015 & prior reserves from Syndicate 1955 into 2016), so triangle-derived PYD would be unreliable. Consequently prior_year_development_gbp_m is set to null. Per-LOB movement amounts are derived from the gross outstanding liabilities table (2017 vs 2018) where prior-year comparatives exist; confidence varies. All monetary source tables are presented in GBP 000 (thousands).
